hooks.name: Plugin security checklist on save
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to apply the security checklist after plugin edits

action.prompt: A perfumarathi-shop plugin file was saved. Before finishing, re-check that file against .kiro/steering/project.md: output escaped, input sanitized, nonce plus capability checks on writes, no raw SQL, no secrets. Run `node --check` on changed JS. Remind the user PHP could not be executed here, so CI must confirm syntax.
